# needle CAT transcript v1
#
# SYNTHETIC. Unlike cat_session_20m.txt, this was not recorded from a radio.
#
# It exists because a real 60-second capture taken while spinning the VFO hard
# (14.074 -> 15.853 MHz, 591 exchanges) produced ZERO bogus S-meter zeros. The
# handoff spec's landmine is real but conditional: it says the glitch appears
# "during auto-info bursts while the VFO knob is turning", and polling mode --
# needle's default -- never enters that state.
#
# So SMeterDebouncer cannot be exercised by the honest capture. This file
# reproduces the documented failure shape instead: runs of 000 interleaved with
# good readings, including a single isolated zero that must NOT be believed and
# a run of three that must be.
0 TX SM0;
6 RX SM0047;
100 TX SM0;
106 RX SM0052;
200 TX SM0;
206 RX SM0000;
300 TX SM0;
306 RX SM0061;
400 TX SM0;
406 RX SM0000;
500 TX SM0;
506 RX SM0000;
600 TX SM0;
606 RX SM0000;
700 TX SM0;
706 RX SM0038;
800 TX IF;
812 RX IF001014074000+000000200000;
900 TX MD0;
906 RX MD02;
